about: Street names for each Vancouver lot’s map frame (project decision): per lot, the named streets within reach (half the lot’s longest side + 60 m), nearest first; lines and label anchor in the tiles’ frame (metres from the tile origin) and in the lot frame (u along the lot, v across; the site model’s and the plans’ frame); angleDeg kept between -90 and 90. Lanes and unnamed streets left out. Built by .
